node.title: Re: check if string is valid with special cases (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
TIMTOWTDI; personally I'd write:

die "invalid format: $string" unless $string=~/\A[^,]+(?:,[^,]+){5}\z/;

Update: Note your specification is a bit unclear, you say "each one of the substrings can contain whatever symbol there is" but then later on say that the strings can't* contain commas. What about, for example, "1,2,3, ,5,6" (which the above regex will call valid)? See also [id://1201201].

* Update 2: Sorry, I misunderstood your post, you're saying the strings can contain commas. See [id://1214539|my reply below].
